tei:div.tei:p: 433) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs tig las: rig byed lha mo'i smin byed dbang gi 'jug ngogs dngos grub snye ma bzhugs: sarba maṅga laṃ: 434) na mo pad+ma kā ra ye: (Dakini secret letter here) rang rig sku gsum mkha' 'gror 'dud: ma 'ongs pad+ma'i rjes 'jug gisaḥ gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du: 'jug cing sgo gsum smin pa dang: srid zhi dbang bsdad las 'grub phyir: smin byed zab dbang 'di ru bstan: sa ma ya: de nas dbang gi sta gon ni: rab 'bring tha ma gang 'os kyi: rten 'brel dkyil 'khor legs par bkod: de'i dbus bum pa bhan thod dang: rig ma shel rdo me long dang: gsang ba'i dbang rdzas rnam gsum bshams: bdag mdun bum lha bskyed bstim bya: dbang blangs slob dpon chas gsol nas: slob bu mdun 'khod dri ma bkrus: bgegs bskrad srung 'khor bsgom pa dang: yid ches dang ba 'dren pa'i phyir: lo rgyas bshad cing maṇ+ḍal phul: de nas gsol ba 'debs pa ni: kyai: bde chen thar pa'i lam ston mchog: dbang ldan rgyal po bla ma dgongs: bdag cag skal ldan bu rnams la: gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i: smin byed dbang gi bka' drin stsol: ces lan gsum bskul: de nas slob dpon gyis: hoḥ rigs ldan bu rnams las 'phro ldan: gsang ba sngags kyi dkyil 'khor du: 'jug par spro na ngas ston gyis: gsang sngags tshul bzhin 435)bsgrub nus sam: ngas bsgo'i bka' las mi 'da' bar: dam tshig ji bzhin bsrung nus sam: nus na gsang sngags dkyil 'khor 'jug: bsrung du mi nus phyir dengs shig: slob bus gdab lan ni: kyai: rdo rje slob dpon mchog nyid dgongs: bdag cag skal ldan dam dang ldan: ci bsgo'i bka' las 'da' mi bya: gsang sngags phyi nang gsang gsum gyi: dam tshig srog gi gta' ru bzung: de nas skyabs sems sdom pa 'bogs: na mo: rgyal kun yum gyur rje btsun ma: ku ru kul+ler skyabs su mchi: bdag gzhan gnyis snang dbang bsdus nas:

'khor ba'i 'jigs las bskyab tu gsol: lan gsum dang sems bskyed ni: hoḥ bcom ldan lha mo'i dkyil 'khor du: bskyed rdzogs rim gnyis la 'jug nas: gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i sems can kun: bde chen zhing la 'god sems bskyed: lan gsum dang dam chu sbyin pa ni: hoḥ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu: skal ldan bu la sbyin pa yin: bsrungs na 'dir sangs rgyas thob: nyams na dmyal bar ltung ta re: de phyir dam tshig ma 'da' zhig: 436)badz+ra sa ma ya na ra kan: de nas mig dar sbyin pa ni: oṃ tsak+ṣu bhan+dha wa ra ma ṇa ye swā hāḥ me tog sbyin pa ni: oṃ pad+ma puṣ+pe sid+dhi trām̐: de nas slob ma lhar bskyed pa ni: oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā= haṃḥ slob ma'i ma dag pa'i phung khams thams cad stong par sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las: skad cig pad+ma nyi zla'i steng: slob ma'i rig pa hrīḥ dmar po: yongs gyur don gnyis byas tshur 'dus: bcom ldan myur dpal lha mo ni: rig byed dmar mo rgya skyegs mdangs: zhal gcig spyan gsum dbyings su gzigs: phyag bzhi dang pos mda' gzhu 'gengs: 'og gnyis lcags kyu zhags pa 'dzin: dar dang rat+na rus rgyan gsol: thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal byas: stag sham smad kris dar snas spras: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum bam ro brdzis: dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'khyil: spyi bor rigs bdag snang mtha' yas: dmar po mnyam bzhag mtshan dpe rdzogs: rigs kun yongs 'dus ngo bor gsal: ye shes 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba'i klong: snang la rang bzhin med par bzhugs: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las: 'bru gsum snying po'i 'od 'phros pas: nub 437)phyogs bde chen zhing khams dang: lho phyogs dbang gi phug pa nas: bcom ldan myur mdzad rgyal ba'i yum: ye shes sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs la: dbang gi lha mo'i rnam pa ru: gnas 'dir gshegs la bskyed pa'i ltar: dam ye dbyer med ro gcig gyur: de nas byin chen dbab pa ni:

hūm̐ hrīḥ nub phyogs bde chen dag pa'i gnas: pad+ma dbang gi gzhal yas nas: khams gsum dbang sdud ḍā ki ma: bcom ldan rig byed rgyal ba'i yum: las mdzad ḍā ki 'khor dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra zur phud ta la la: rin chen rgyan cha si li li: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad lhangs se lhang: byin rlabs na bun thibs se thib: dngos grub char chen thu lu lu: mi gnas ye shes dkyil 'khor nas: skal ldan sgo gsum byin gyis rlobs: srid gsum dbang sdud byin chen phobs: snang rtog lha yi phyag rgyar rdzogs: sgra grags bde chen sngags su dag: dran rtog ye shes chen por smin: 'ja' lus chen por byin chen phobs: sgo gsum rdo rjer byin gyis rlobs: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phobs la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur: bgegs dag log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog 438)thun su kha'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥsarba sa ma ya pheṃ pheṃ a be sha ya ā āḥ zhes brjod me tog 'thor bzhin: ye shes dbab pa de nyid slob ma'i sgo gsum la rab tu gnas shing brtan par gyur cig: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: de nas me tog dor ba ni: hoḥ khyed cag skal ldan las 'phro can: sngon gyi yi dam gang yin pa: rdo rje rgyal po'i ting 'dzin gyis: me tog de ru dbab par byed: lha de ma brjed yid la zungs: gsang mtshan 'dzin cing dngos grub thob: oṃ badz+ra dzñā na buṣ+pe sid+dhi trām̐: de nas dbang rtogs bstan pa ni: khyed rang rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha la me tog dor bas: shar du babs na rdo rje dbang chen: lho ru babs na rin chen dbang rgyal: nub tu babs na pad+ma rig 'dzin: byang du babs na karma dbang phyug: dbus su babs na sangs rgyas dbang po: shar lhor babs na tshe dbang don grub: lho nub tu babs na 'jam dpal dbang phyug: nub byang du babs na rta mgrin dbang rgyal:

byang shar du babs na rnam dag kun dbang la sogs pa rang rang gi rigs kyi gsang mtshan rnams ma brjed par mdzod cig: de nas mig dar bsal ba ni: kyai hoḥ thabs mchog rdo rje rgyal po 439)yis: khyod kyi ma rig sgrib pa'i bag: ye shes gser gyi thur mas dbye: chos nyid spyan dang ldan nas kyang: rang byung ye shes mthong bar shog: oṃ badz+ra tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya phaṭaḥ de nas mthong ba bstan pa ni: e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu: chos sku ye shes spros dang bral: rang byung lhun grub rol pa'i rtsal: sor rtogs ye shes dkyil 'khor bkod: rig byed lha mo'i rten brten pa: skal ldan khyod la bstan pa yis: lha dang snang ba chos nyid gsum: gzhan na med do rang rig klong: ngo bos gding thob rtsal rdzogs mdzod: 'di nyid mthong bas bag chags dag: dngos grub ma lus thob par 'gyur: bh+rūm̐ dzñā na maṇ+ḍal la pra be sha ya a āḥ de nas dngos gzhi'i dbang zhu ba'i phyir maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: kye ho mgon po thugs rje can: bdag cag skal ldan bu mchog la: dbang gi lha mo'i dngos gzhi'i dbang: yongs rdzogs gnang ba'i bka' drin stsol: lan gsum mthar gdab lan ni: e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu: rdo rje slob dpon thabs mkhas pas: dbang rnams khyod la bdag gis 440)bstsal: dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung nus sam: bsgo ba'i bka' las ma 'da' bar: bsrungs na tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob: nyams na dmyal bar ltung ta re: de bas dam tshig ma 'da' srungs: badz+ra sa ma ya na ra kan: zhes brjod dam chu blud: de nas bum pa thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ chos dbyings rol pa'i bum pa'i nang: ye shes bdud rtsi bla na med: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bum pa sku yi dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: de nas sku gzugs thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ chos sku skye med kun bzang mo: 'gags med rang gdangs dbang gis lha:

rig byed ḍā ki'i dbang bskur ro: dngos grub rnam gnyis dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ de nas bdud rtsi thogs la: hūm̐: gsal stong 'gags med bhan+dha'i nang: brjod bral rang grol bdud rtsis bkang: dbang gis lha mo'i gsung gi bcud: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bzlas pa ngag gi sgrib dag nas: grags stong brjod med dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rig ma thogs la: hūm̐ hrī: bcu drug dga' ster mchog gi pho nya mo: bde stong ye shes 441)chen po bskyed pa'i grogs: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la gtad pa yis: 'bar 'dzag dgram 'dren thabs la dbang thob nas: rtsa rlung thig le'i sgrib pa kun dag nas: bde stong dga' bzhi'i ye shes smin pa dang: 'od gsal sgyu lus zung 'jug skur rdzogs nas: shes rab ye shes dbang mchog thob par shog: rtsa sngags: a haṃ ma hā su kha bo dhi tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ de nas shel rdo me long thogs la: āḥ rig pa'i rang bzhin brjod pa bral: rnam thar gsum ldan stong pa nyid: spros mtha' brgyad bral 'od gsal che: rang gsal sku dang ye shes ni: chos nyid dag pa'i ye gdangs rdzogs: man shel me long stong pa'i mtshon: gsal la sgrib med brda yi dbang: skal ldan bu la bskur ba yis: las rlung sems gsum gnas dag nas: 'od gsal chos skur smin grol shog: rtsa sngags: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: a a a phaṭaḥ de nas spro ba bskyed pa ni: slob bu rdo rje chos bdun gyis bzhugs la: slob dpon gyis 'di skad gdab: a a āḥ drag ma bcad thon par bya gnas slob bu la rtog med du ngo sprod pa ni: e ma 442)skal ldan rigs kyi bu: ma yengs ma yengs ngang la klod: rang sems chos sku'i ngo bor ltos: blta bya lta byed gnyis med pa: gsal stong ye rig ngang du rkyongs: blo 'das chos sku chen po ni: nam mkha' rang bzhin mtha' dbus med:

gang la mi 'jug yul mi 'dzin: mi gnas mi 'khrul ma rig bral: dag grol gnyis ldan rdzogs sangs rgyas: rang byung rig pa de ka'o: gzhan na med do rigs kyi bu: spro ba bskyed la mnyam par zhog: zhes brjod nas thugs yid bsre: de nas dbang rdzas rnam gsum thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ bcom ldan 'das ma dbang gi lha'i: yon tan gsang rdzas rig gsum gyis: skal ldan bu la byugs pa yis: khams gsum dbang sdud ḍā ki'i rten: gang 'dod dbang sdud dbang thob shog: ces brjod nas: hūm̐: sin+dhu+u ra: āḥ mtshal: oṃ: li khri: yas rim nas thig le gnas gsum du byugs: de nas mda' gzhu thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ thabs shes brda mtshon ut+pal mda' dang gzhu: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la gtad pa yis: bcom ldan 'das ma'i phrin las dbang thob nas: rab 'byams shes bya'i chos la dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: sarba gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐: 443)de nas lcags zhags thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ khams gsum dbang bsdud lcags kyu zhags pa 'di: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la gtad pa yis: snang srid mos pa rnam bzhi dbang bsdus nas: chos srid dpal la rol pa'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: sarba gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐ hrī: ka dag spros bral gtor gzhong du: lhun grub rang byung ba liṃ ta: dbang gi lha mo sgrub pa'i rten: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: sgo 'dir 'jug pa'i dbang thob nas: don gnyis mdzad pa mthar phyin shog: rtsa sngags: ma hā ba liṃ ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas bka' dbang ni: hoḥ chos sku kun tu bzang po: drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen: ston pa rdo rje sems dpa': gu ru dga' rab rdo rje: rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas: gar dbang klu sgrub snying po: paṇa chen bzhad pa rdo rje: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal: kun dga' su kha sid+dhi la sogs pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams la dbang bskur bar mdzad du gsol:

ye shes dang yon tan thams cad rgyud la brtan par mdzad du gsol: rim pa gnyis 444)īkyi lam mthar phyin nas sgyu lus 'od skur smin par mdzad du gsol: tshe 'dir bcom ldan 'das rig byed lha mo mngon sum du 'grub nas khams gsum srid gsum 'khor 'das thams cad dbang du bsdus nas bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che 'grub nas mthar thug gdod ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig: ces brjod gtor ma gnas gsum du gtug go: de nas mtha' rten gtad cing me tog 'thor: khas blangs yon phul bkra shis brjod: dge bsngo dga' ston tshogs 'khor bya: sa ma ya: e ma gsang ba'i yang bcud 'di: pad+ma cod pan rgyud bcu gsum: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gis zhus: snying mig srog las phongs na yang: nam snying shel dkar gnyis la gdams: da dung ma spel thugs dam mdzod: ma 'ongs dus kyi mtha' ma la: nga sprul kun dga' dī paṃ dang: su kha badz+ra yos 'brug lo: tha mal tshul 'dzin gter la dbang: nam snying g.yu sgra'i grogs dang 'phrad: de dus chos 'di 'phrad nas kyang: rigs ldan bu slob lnga 'byung gnas: chos 'di'i bstan pa yul lngar rgyas: gcig brgyud gyis la rim bzhin spel: 'brel ba thob tshad don gnyis 'grub: phyi ma bde chen zhing la spyod: the tshom med do rdo rje tshig: bdud sprul pā shaṃ ming 'dzin pa: g.yo can gdong sme g.yas 445)na mdzes: thabs kyis spyod cing grol lam la: 'jug nus mthu rtsal ma ldan na: shar gyi me tog lho ru 'phen: zab gter nam mkha'i pad+mor 'gyur: thabs ldan grol ba thob pas na: drug cu lnga bar rim gyis gdul bya rdzogs: de dus nga dang dbyer med dpal rir yibs: sa ma ya: chos 'dzin rigs kyi bu lnga ni: g.yu sgra'i sprul pa gu h+ya'i ming: lus thung sme ba'i dga' 'khyil ni: stod smad mtshams su ri mo bkra: nam snying sprul pa lo ka'i ming: yos lo shes rab mig dang ldan:

sngags rig 'dzin pa shar nas 'byung: a tsar sprul pa badz+ra ming: brla g.yas g.yung drung ri mo yod: yal gam lo 'dzin gter la dbang: rma thog sprul pa sa man+ta: mkhal g.yon sha khra'i ri mo yod: gser gyi lto 'gro'i lto bar 'khyil: 'brog mi'i sprul pa 'dul gyi ming: mchan g.yon sme ba dmar nag ni: lha yi spyan 'dra rab tu mdzes: de dag ri dang nye ba'i sar: rten 'brel dbang gis 'dzom par 'gyur: sngags rigs sam ni btsun pa'i tshul: chos 'di dpal du spyod pa 'byung: dharma'i ming dang pā shaṃ ming: wāk+ka'i ming dang gu h+ya'i ming: pradzñā'i ming dang su kha'i ming: rasmi'i ming dang puṇ+ye'i ming: bimok+ṣadang kirti'i ming: de la sogs pa'i chos bdag 446)ni: dus dang dus su 'phrad par 'gyur: sa ma ya: drug cu lnga nas 'dul bya rim gyis rdzogs: shaṃ bha la ru smon lam dbang gis bgrod: de nas 'dong chu lha khang zhes pa na: bde ba'i ming 'dzin shes rab spyan can 'byung: smon lam dus su sad nas bstan 'gror sman: zab mo'i chos sgo sna tshogs de dus 'byed: rten 'brel ldan cing sa gter lnga la dbang: gsang grogs klong gi ming 'dzin brtul zhugs ldan: sngags rigs 'chang ba smon lam dbang gis 'phrad: zab gter khrol sdom bstan pa de la rag: chos srid 'du sgo bsam mi khyab pa dang: chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i skyes bu 'ga' yang 'byung: 'brel tshad rnam par grol pa'i lam la bkod: the tshom med do bdag gi bka' mi bslu: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: log lta 'dod sred mkhan gyi dbang po bsnubs: bka' srung gnod sbyin gza' dang ma mos srungs: dam nyams lag tu ma shor sa ma ya: sku rgya: gsung rgya: thugs rgya: zas rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: gu h+ya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di yang zab gter rgya mtsho'i grogs ldan gter chen chos kyi rgyal po o rgyan dngos snang pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang:

rin chen gnyis pa dbang mdog bzang po'i skyes bcas yang yang nan cher gsung bskul phebs ba dang: nye char chos kyi bdag po sprul pa'i sku sa man+ta sur+ya'-i mtshan 'chang dang: skyes bu shī la badz+ra rnams kyi 447)nan tan chen pos yang yang bskul ngor/ gang gi zhabs su bsdus pa slob 'bangs yongs kyi tha shal mdo med 'chol mo dus mtha'i gter ming 'dzin pa bde chen bde ba'i rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i shog ser las dag par phabs pa dge'o// ༈ rig byed ma'i dbang gi skabs su kha bsgyur ni/ da lan gyi skabs su bab pa mchod sdong bya rung kha shor nas spyan drangs pa'i zab gter bcom ldan rig byed lha mo'i smin byed dbang gi 'jug ngogs dngos grub snye ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa: sogs dbang gi lhan thabs ltar ro/ bde ba'i rdo rjes so// 448)
